inference.inference_model_scope: Counts, sums and histograms are per-collection deltas; queue_wait_max_seconds is since service start

service.timing_note: Host elapsed time; CUDA forward kernel duration is in optional profiler traces

measurement.cpu_scope: Sampled lower bound, 50ms; initial processes baselined; nested phases overlap

cache_scope: Cold worker processes; preloaded GPU models; second replay read/preparation is warm
